اخرنمست (form IIIq)
# اِخْرَنْمَسْتُ (iḵranmastu) /ix.ran.mas.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
# اِخْرَنْمَسْتَ (iḵranmasta) /ix.ran.mas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
# اِخْرَنْمَسْتِ (iḵranmasti) /ix.ran.mas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
# اِخْرَنْمَسَتْ (iḵranmasat) /i
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
